escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark digital studio at night): a Latin American web lead in his early thirties, short dark hair and a trimmed beard, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE POLO, stands on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with a confident half-smile. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. With one raised hand he is sliding a module into place inside a HUGE floating holographic WEBSITE that towers beside and behind him: a translucent, glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) web page made of light, with a hero block, navigation bar, image cards, buttons and a search bar, layered in depth like panes of glass, its edges sharp and luminous, every tiny text on it too small and too blurred to read. Three kinds of visitors are using the website at the same time: a glowing white mouse cursor with a light trail clicking a button; a bright beam of light sweeping across the page like a search engine crawler; and three small friendly robot agents, each the size of a football, round glossy white bodies with navy panels and big expressive azure LED eyes, with cheerful comic faces, walking along the page's layout, one reading a card with a tiny flashlight, one pressing a button, one waving. The hologram is the main light source and throws azure light on his face, polo and the haze, with a few teal (#36C8BF) and magenta (#E86BD0) highlights inside the page. Cool rim light from behind. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with no hologram, no robots and no objects, only faint haze. Rich contrast, punchy color, no logos of any other brand.

lecho.objeto: the dark blurred edge of a desk close to the lens, outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark studio space on the left 45% of the frame
